processes.name: Dealer Quoting & Sales Coordination
processes.description: Priya Ellwood handles dealer requests via Outlook/calls, checks IDs against an Excel list, and populates a quote template. Tessa Bellamy approves quotes, manages the pricing/formula workbook, and handles ~100 exceptional pricing questions annually. Quotes are offers until written acceptance.
pain_points: Reliance on manual routing for calls/messages

processes.name: Order Intake & Production Scheduling
processes.description: Upon written dealer acceptance, Priya creates an order in Excel and a paper build packet. Jonah Sutter assigns unique WO identifiers, sets target dates (estimates, not guarantees), sequences work weekly in Excel/whiteboard, and hands packets to the floor. Supervisors report progress/exceptions back to Jonah for schedule updates.
pain_points: Target dates treated as promises by dealers

processes.name: Purchasing, Receiving & Inventory Management
processes.description: Devon Kersey oversees purchasing; Jalen Sorrell creates POs. Cora Whitlock hand-counts 6 frequent SKUs weekly, updates an Excel stock sheet, and records receipts against POs. Exceptions go to Devon. QuickBooks is for bills only; Excel/paper are working shop-floor counts.
pain_points: Discrepancy between accounting system (QuickBooks) and working inventory (Excel/paper)
Manual cycle counting of only 6 SKUs
Shortage handling causes worker idle time

processes.name: Shipping, Invoicing & Month-End Close
processes.description: Mateo Renshaw schedules shipments and sends confirmations. Elena Corwin issues dealer invoices in QuickBooks at shipment (net 30). Lydia Fenner oversees monthly close: bank/AP/AR reconciliation, shipping vs invoice comparison, management summary export/re-keying to Excel, and checklist signoff.
pain_points: Close timeline often extends beyond 5-day target (e.g., October open at snapshot)
No named backup for Controller signoff

processes.name: Warranty Claims & Returns Processing
processes.description: Priya receives dealer warranty messages, forwards details/photos to Iris Calder. Iris opens claims (CLM-YYYY-NNNN), verifies components, approves dealer repairs before work starts, and closes claims upon completion evidence. No blanket coverage rule; each claim reviewed individually.
pain_points: No backup repair approver if Iris is unavailable
Manual tracking via Excel index/email threads

processes.name: Payroll & Time Card Administration
processes.description: Nia Hadley collects paper time cards/exception notices, resolves omissions, enters biweekly hours into RUN Powered by ADP, reviews totals with Controller Lydia Fenner, and submits payroll. 36 hourly staff use cards; 14 salaried use exception notices. Supervisors approve direct reports' cards.
pain_points: Unclear legal overtime classification based on pay basis alone
No named backup payroll submitter or approver

doc_vs_reality_gaps.document_says: Jonah Sutter, Production Scheduler, keeps the Excel schedule and the shop whiteboard. Owen Bellamy, Plant Manager, owns the floor.
